description: 1:1 with Quibblesworth: I own the moonlight-capture lens, Nimbus owns the juicing chamber
body:
## Decided
- I own the moonlight-capture lens.
- Nimbus Pratt owns the juicing chamber.

## Commitments
- Me: lens design draft to Quibblesworth by 2026-06-30.

description: Chose Glorp Logistics over Speedy Snail to ship moonberries: $2.10 a crate, 3 days versus 9 weeks
body:
## Decided
Glorp Logistics ships the moonberries.

- Glorp: $2.10 a crate, 3 days door to door
- Speedy Snail Couriers: $1.80 a crate, about 9 weeks, by which time the berries are jam

Quibblesworth agreed.
